page.layout: One block of verse in the centre of the page, full width, lines in couplets with indented second lines; a catchword "Nunc" at the lower right below the last line.

main_text.p:
Hanc natus genitore Deo, qui fœderis obses,
Lethæo veteres carcere traxit auos.

Nec voluit seros Erebo parere nepotes,
Colla sed excusso libera ferre iugo.

Victricis vexilla Crucis, credentibus omen
Extulit, imperij signa futura sui.

Vmbrarum hæc oculis haud aspicit arbiter æquis,
Sævit, & auxilijs expedit arma nouis.

In Crucis excidium Latias aptare secures
Apparat, & dominæ concitat urbis opem.

Primáque Cæsareus tentauit verbera lictor
Incassum, & rabie proficiente nihil.

Nam lignum Crucis ad quosvis obduruit ictus,
Statúque magis, quanto cædituc illa magis.

Christiadûmque fides numerum cruciatibus auget,
Et Crucis imperium crescere pœna facit.

Crux vicit crucis artifices, tormenta propago,
Vnus & innumeros Christus in orbe Deos.

Non tamen antiquus furiarum in sede quiescit
Hostis, at indicto prælia Marte ciet.

Omnia conquirit pœnarum inuenta, tyrannos,
Monstra, faces, laqueos, slagra, metalla, feras.

Donec Romuleos Christi victoria fasces
Subdidit, & victo Cæsare iura dedit.

Hinc aquilæ cessêre Cruci, vastumque per orbem
Crux fuit augustis gloria prima viris.

Vt quoties fera barbaries, aut nominis hostis
Christiadûm, sacræ mouerit arma Cruci,

Arsacides, vel mollis Arabs, Macedûmque phalanges,
Pontus, & Ismarij Luna superba dacis;

Aut Scytha, vel Garamas, mediis vel Syrtibus Ammen,
Errorum aut furiis gens agitata nouis,

Protinus intrepidis animis, armisque paratis,
Sancta salutifera pro Cruce turba stetit.

page.notes: Catchword "Nunc" at lower right. Ligatures and long-s forms rendered as plain s; some words in the scan are uncertain, notably "cædituc" (line 7 of couplet 7, likely "cæditur") and "dacis" (likely "Dacis"). Printed "Ismarij" and "Macedûmque" kept as printed.
